claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is policy-compliant because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and a 5% monitored rollout with rollback is sufficient despite a known below-target school-admissions advising limitation.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the affected use case is excluded from rollout or an approved risk acceptance covers the exposure, or the required model-card disclosure is demonstrably in place.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents support general launch readiness but do not by themselves satisfy the disclosure policy predicate.
Monitoring, rollback, and small-percentage rollout are mitigation layers, not substitutes for disclosure when exposure remains.
Absent proof of disclosure or approved risk acceptance, the certification claim is not fully supported by admissible evidence.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model card text or approval artifact showing explicit disclosure of the admissions advising limitation for the named launch use case.
Provide any approved risk acceptance that specifically addresses continued exposure of the below-target admissions advising segment.
Provide launch cohort documentation showing whether the affected use case is excluded; if not, confirm the disclosure was reviewed and accepted before launch.
specific_concerns: The policy text says rollout controls do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
The actor summary says the school admissions advising segment remains below target and is still included in the initial rollout cohort.
The available risk acceptance is described as a draft, not approved, and does not address the exposed admissions advising segment.
No admissible evidence is provided that the required model-card disclosure has actually been included before certification.
The actor's certification rationale is explicitly conditional on disclosure, leaving a required policy predicate unresolved on the present record.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the current record rather than only conditionally supportable if explicit model-card disclosure is already in place.
That rollout at 5% with rollback and monitoring can substitute for disclosure while the affected use case remains exposed.
That the known limitation is adequately covered by risk acceptance.
